name: American Airlines
note: American charges 5 USD less if you pay online rather than at the airport, and 5 USD more if you are on a Basic Economy ticket. The figures below are the standard online price. Weight and size limits are behind a collapsed section on American's page and are not recorded here because they were not stated in the source.

baggage.label: Checked bags, US and nearby

rows.item: First checked bag, paid at airport
Second checked bag, paid at airport

caveats: Travel within or between the US, Puerto Rico, US Virgin Islands, Canada, the Caribbean (except Cuba and Haiti), Mexico, Central America (except Panama) and Guyana.
Basic Economy pays 5 USD more for both the first and second bag.
Paying online saves 5 USD per bag against paying at the airport.
Fees are per person and per direction of travel.
Bag fees paid at the airport are non-refundable. If you pay for bags and later receive an upgrade that includes free bags, the fee you already paid is not refunded.
These allowances and fees were updated on 18 May 2026.
Up to 10 bags on American-operated domestic, trans-Atlantic and trans-Pacific flights; up to 5 to or through Mexico, the Caribbean, Central America, South America and Brazil.
Cuba is capped at 2 checked bags at 70 lb each, and since 26 August 2025 even Executive Platinum, Platinum Pro and oneworld Emerald members are limited to 2 free bags on Cuba routes.
